notes: v0.1 Factual pack (ADR-0025). Contains the FSSAI RDA denominators, the nutrient synonym table, INS additive records and the confidence assignment table. rules/thresholds.json is deliberately empty: Layer 2 advisory thresholds are v0.2 scope and are not fabricated here. EVALUATION ORDER: rules/confidence.json 'assignment' is an ORDERED list and the first matching rule wins. The anyInvariantFailed rule is first so that FR-CNF-05 holds absolutely; reordering it would silently break that guarantee. PERMISSION EVIDENCE: every additive's indianPermission is traced to Appendix A of the FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011, which was fetched and read on 2026-08-04. Appendix A lists additives BY NAME per food product and contains NO INS numbers, so each evidence entry records the name as printed. Only Tables 1 and 2 were examined; status UNKNOWN means not found in that scope and NEVER means prohibited. Permission never extends beyond the foodProducts cited. Tolerances are provisional pending corpus calibration (Q14). INTEGRITY HASH: the algorithm is specified normatively in DATA_MODEL.md section 7.2 and this note is descriptive only. In summary: sha256 over the eight CONTENT files, excluding manifest.json, schema/* and LICENSE, in ascending byte-wise order of UTF-8 relative path, feeding the path bytes then the file bytes with no separator, rendered as lower-case hex behind a 'sha256:' prefix. It detects corruption and tampering; it is NOT a signature and proves nothing about origin. Recomputed by tool/compute_rulepack_hash.py and enforced by CI-17.
